name: scene-transition
title: Scene Transition
description: A wipe that sweeps the screen (or a container) between two sections or pages, in steps: four frames to cover, a hold, four frames to uncover, at 12 fps, swapping the scene while the screen is covered. Across in the reading order (right to left with data-reading="rtl" or dir="rtl") or downward. Variants: ink (an ink flat), tone (a 50% screentone on paper edged with ink lines), panels (four ink panels with paper gutters dropped one per frame). An optional caption pops in the middle during the hold, on a paper narration box. As a hook (useSceneTransition: play(swap) returns a promise) or a component (playing, onCovered, onDone). The overlay is aria-hidden and catches clicks while it plays; with reduced motion the scene is swapped at once.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/scene-transition". With scope="container", render the transition inside a positioned element (relative, overflow hidden). Move focus to the new scene yourself once the promise resolves (or in onDone).

meta.tagline: A stepped wipe between two scenes.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ink flat, 50% screentone, or four ink panels.

props.name: direction
props.description: Across in the reading order, or from top to bottom.

props.name: scope
props.description: Fixed over the viewport, or over the nearest positioned ancestor.

props.name: caption
props.description: Narration box shown in the middle while covered.

props.name: playing
props.description: Component only: plays each time it turns true.

props.name: onCovered / onDone
props.description: Component only: swap the scene / the scene is uncovered.

props.name: frame
props.description: Component only: freezes one frame, for previews.
